description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

  • Lisbon, PT

Available Terms

  • Winter/Spring (January - May 2027) 
  • Summer (May - September 2027)

About the Role

Anytime we push code, it automatically affects the millions of Internet properties (powering websites, remote teams, APIs, mobile apps, etc.) running on our global network. Cloudflare's network is one of the largest in the world and spans over 330 cities in more than 125 countries. What's more, Cloudflare operates within 50 milliseconds of 95% of the Internet-connected population globally (for context, the blink of an eye is 300-400 milliseconds!). We are passionate about making the Internet more secure, reliable, and faster for everyone.

Cloudflare’s Engineering teams build and run the software that handles the massive amount of traffic that flows through our network. We also have teams that build the UI and control plane for our software, using modern patterns and libraries in a microservices-based architecture. Technologies include: Typescript/Javascript, Go, Rust, C/C++ and Python.

The ideal intern is passionate about making the Internet a better place. You will work alongside experienced engineers. You will push code this internship that touches hundreds of millions of web surfers. We like to get things done, so we are looking for interns who are curious, proactive, and able to complete projects. This is a great opportunity for engineers who want to learn to develop at Internet scale.

You can check out our internship blogs to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.

Responsibilities

  • Ship and deliver projects over 12-14 weeks with autonomy and support.
  • Work cross-functionally with various teams.
  • Work closely with a mentor to guide you through the internship and help with career goals.
  • Build your network across the company through our various in and out of office socials, networking programs, Employee Resource Group (ERG) programs, and Activity Groups.
  • Present your project to the entire company at the end of the internship.
  • Connect and learn from our executives and leadership team including our co-founders.
  • Learn and develop skills through our professional development workshops.
  • Write for our Cloudflare blog and be featured on Cloudflare.tv sessions. 

Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience

  • Currently pursuing a degree or program in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or relevant field to the role.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking skills and drive to learn and adapt new technologies.
  • Curiosity, empathy and ability to get things done.
  • Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship.
  • In office 3-5 days a week in Lisbon, PT.

Bonus Points

Demonstrated passion for software development, such as personal projects, open-source contributions, or experience with our developer platform using Cloudflare for Students.

  • For Portugal based hires: the monthly salary is €2,450.

Please note

  • We will be hiring interns on a rolling basis until all roles are filled.
  • We are not considering remote or part-time for either terms. This is a full-time (40hr/week internship) with in-person expectations; standard business hours are typically 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM. You should not be enrolled in classes, which would conflict with full-time commitment.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Behind that technology is a Finance team building the financial infrastructure to support a growing company. We are looking for a highly organized, analytical, and detail-oriented Finance Intern to join our New York office and work directly with our Controller.

This is a hands-on role. You will work with real financial data, transactions, reconciliations, client media spend, reporting, and month-end close activities not just administrative tasks or theoretical exercises.

You will also gain exposure to how AI and automation can improve finance processes, reduce manual work, and analyze large datasets.

What You Will Do

  • Accounting & Operations: Support AP/AR, reconciliations, and day-to-day accounting while maintaining accurate financial data.
  • Media Spend Tracking: Reconcile high-volume media spend and learn how gross vs. net revenue works in an AdTech business.
  • Financial Reporting: Support month-end close and preparation of financial reports.
  • Financial Modeling: Gain exposure to forecasting and financial modeling.

What We're Looking For

  • Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/  Graduate degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related field. 
  • December 2027 graduation is ideal; May 2027 or later will also be considered.
  • Coursework or experience in accounting, finance, bookkeeping, or data analytics.
  • Strong proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel and comfort working with large datasets.
  • Exposure to QuickBooks Online, Xero, or similar accounting systems is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.
  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, or other data tools.
  • Interest in AI, AdTech, SaaS, automation, or financial technology is a plus.
  • Ability to work on-site in our Midtown Manhattan office 4+ days per week.

Who You Are

  • Detail-Oriented: You care about accuracy and catch discrepancies.

Responsibilities:

Refresh it weekly so GSMs and program management can see which parts have no supplier on paper.

Found Industries is a Cambridge, MA-based industrial technology company building new critical supply chains from resources and infrastructure hiding in plain sight. Launched out of MIT, Found develops and deploys technologies that unlock critical materials and dispatchable clean energy from overlooked industrial feedstocks.

The company operates through two complementary business units: Found Metals and Found Energy. Found Metals recovers strategic materials, including gallium, from existing industrial processing streams. Found Energy converts aluminum, including low-grade and scrap material, into a fuel for behind-the-meter industrial heat and power. The two businesses reinforce one another: Found Metals expands domestic supplies of critical materials used in advanced energy technologies, while Found Energy creates new applications and demand for those materials. Together, they form the foundation of a broader industrial platform focused on strengthening U.S. energy and materials security.

At Found Industries, we are building the industrial capabilities needed for a more resilient and self-reliant future. We believe secure access to critical materials and energy is foundational to economic strength, national security, and long-term prosperity, and we are looking for talented people motivated by that mission to join us. At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts. Whether it’s medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.

Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity. 

Are you looking to be an AI & SAAS Support Intern on a growing team? If so, this may be the role for you!

You will be the face of FourKites to our customers—their main point of contact for everything they need. From helping customers track urgent shipments to providing assistance to carriers hauling the loads, you will be the product expert and go-to person to help users when they reach out. This internship is designed for hands-on, experiential learning—you'll get real exposure to how a growing SaaS platform operates, with occasional opportunities to support AI-related initiatives alongside our product and engineering teams.

What you'll be doing:

  • First point of contact for FourKites customers, partners & consultants to research, troubleshoot, replicate, and test product problems and bugs
  • Track issue progress and provide regular updates to clients until incidents are resolved
  • Interface with Development, QA, and Consulting Services as needed to resolve customer issues
  • Occasionally support AI-related tasks or initiatives as they arise within the support workflow (limited scope)
  • Be part of weekend rotation for 24/7 customer emergencies

About the team: Our product and engineering teams are dedicated to providing the industry's best-in-class end-to-end supply chain visibility platform. We are committed to building a high-performing team with software craftsman-thinking who are dedicated to developing and enhancing our core platform, and we want you to be a central part of it! We help companies transform their end-to-end supply chain with real-time visibility. Over 600 of the world's most recognized brands, including 9 of the top-10 CPG and 18 of the top-20 Food & Beverage companies, trust FourKites to digitize their supply chains for greater agility, efficiency, and sustainability.

  • Excellent problem-solving & analytical skills
  • Detail-oriented
  • Ability to multitask & work independently as well as collaboratively in a global team environment
  • Able to work under pressure and handle difficult & escalated customer situations with diplomacy & tact

  • No arrears or backlogs

FourKites® is the #1 supply chain visibility platform in the world, extending visibility beyond transportation into yards, warehouses, stores and beyond.   • Macbook Air or Macbook Pro
  • Work with Fortune-100 customers
  • Cutting edge Technologies
  • Online self-paced learning portal
  • Free 24/7 snacks & beverages
  • Catered lunch on Wednesdays

description:
MANUFACTURING ENGINEERING INTERN, CNC MACHINING (SUMMER 2027)

Freeform builds AI-native manufacturing systems that unify software, hardware, and physics to produce industrial-scale parts at the speed of human ideation. By treating manufacturing as a single integrated system, we unlock a new era of innovation where complex hardware is designed, built, and scaled without limits.

As a Manufacturing Engineering Intern (CNC Machining), you will play a critical role in achieving Freeform’s goal of becoming the world leader in the manufacturing of high-value metal 3D printed parts. You will be responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing CNC programs for precision machining operations as well as working closely with our engineers and machinist to establish machining standards for Freeform’s high-volume, vertically integrated machining workflow. You’ll use top of the line multi-axis machines - including DMG Mori and Haas - to develop complex geometries and refine machining processes for maximum efficiency, quality, and repeatability. The ideal candidate is highly technical, hands-on, and thrives in a fast-paced development environment. If you want to be at the forefront of the next era of manufacturing technology, we’d love to hear from you!

3D printing experience is not required to be successful here—we look for smart, motivated, and collaborative individuals who love tackling complex challenges and building world-class technology!  

 

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in developing, implementing, and optimizing CNC programs for complex metal components, including post-processing of 3D printed parts
  • Support programming, setup, and refinement of operations on multi-axis CNC machines (DMG Mori and Haas)
  • Interpret CAD models, technical drawings, and GD&T specifications to help create precise machining programs
  • Help select and evaluate cutting tools, speeds, feeds, and machining strategies for efficiency and repeatability
  • Assist in troubleshooting CNC programming issues, collaborating with machinists and design engineers
  • Help create, maintain, and update CNC program libraries, tool databases, best practices, and process documentation
  • Contribute to process improvement projects that increase productivity, reduce cycle times, and improve machine utilization
  • Collaborate with additive designers on custom workholding and help identify whether design or process changes are the right fix for a given issue
  • Support the design and deployment of automation solutions that enhance quality control and production rates
  • Work on the production floor to gain hands-on experience with machining, setup, and troubleshooting
  • Follow quality control processes, industry standards, and safety regulations
  • Own an intern project from scoping through implementation, and present results to the team at the end of the term

Basic Qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering from an ABET accredited university or college 
  • Exposure to CNC programming and machining through coursework, labs, makerspace, internships, or collegiate engineering clubs (e.g., Formula SAE, Baja, rocketry, robotics)
  • Familiarity with Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with MasterCAM or Hypermill
  • Experience with 5-axis machines
  • Experience with DMG Mori and Siemens controls
  • Experience machining hard metals such as titanium or Inconel
  • Exposure to automation programming for probe alignment, in-situ quality checks, and adaptive process compensation based on measurement feedback
  • Familiarity with metal 3D printed parts and their post-processing requirements
  • Familiarity with machining castings or forgings
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on approach to debugging machining processes
  • Experience with quality control tools, including CMM, micrometers, and thread gauges
  • Ability to work with power tools, hand tools, and other shop equipment (training provided for cranes, forklifts, and other heavy equipment)
  • Comfortable lifting/moving up to 50 lbs and standing for extended periods
  • Willingness to work extra hours when needed

Location:

  • Based in Hawthorne, our vertically integrated facility brings technology development, R&D, and production together under one roof. We operate at the center of LA’s deep tech ecosystem, surrounded by some of the most ambitious hardware innovation happening anywhere in the country.
  • Our fast-paced, cross-functional environment is built on close collaboration, and as such, this role requires full-time onsite presence (five days a week), with very limited exceptions.

What We Offer:

  • We have an inclusive and diverse culture that values collaboration, learning, and making deliberate data-driven decisions

Spend your summer building digital twins of the labs behind next-generation AI systems.

As a Digital Twin Engineering Intern, you will support virtual models of data lab spaces, equipment and infrastructure during a 12-week, full-time summer internship.

You will help turn engineering information into accurate 3D scenes and reusable digital assets. Your work will support teams developing and testing advanced AI compute systems in Austin.

You will create models, integrate facilities data, check accuracy and document your approach. You will also compare digital twins with drawings, layouts, records and physical environments.

The Digital Twin Engineering team connects physical infrastructure with virtual tools. Work happens through clear modeling tasks, engineering data, structured reviews and feedback from experienced engineers.

You will gather information from engineers and stakeholders, then turn it into usable digital twin assets. Accuracy matters, and decisions are guided by drawings, records, measurements and real lab conditions.

The team values curiosity, organization and people who ask questions early. You will have defined work, regular guidance and the chance to improve how virtual lab environments are built.

description:
About us:

Kiva is a global nonprofit, founded in 2005, with a mission to expand financial access and help underserved communities thrive. Kiva unlocks capital for borrowers through crowdfunded loans supported by individuals around the world. Lenders on Kiva can start with as little as $25 to support causes that matter most to them, whether that’s gender equity and support for women, refugees, climate change, small businesses, agriculture, and more. Since our founding, over two million people have invested over $2 billion in real dreams and real opportunity, spanning more than 100 countries and over 5 million borrowers.

As we work toward our mission, Kiva invests in building and retaining a global team of talent to add to our values-driven and digital-first culture. Our organization is supported by over 700 volunteers and 130+ full-time employees dispersed around the world, as well as within team hubs located in San Francisco, Nairobi, Bogota, and Bangkok. Kiva’s team is growing as we pursue exciting new opportunities to scale our impact and create a financially inclusive world.

Kiva's values:

Impact first - This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.

Extreme ownership - Own it; you, your relationships, your impact. Insist that others support you and hold you accountable.

Be curious and bold - Never stop learning. Question assumptions. Take Risks and dream big.

Inclusion. Equity. Diversity. - Without reservation and without caveat. In our hiring, in our workplace and in our impact in the world.

Honor and integrity - Do the most right thing in the most right way. Cherish diversity and respect each other.

Love and kindness always - Say what you mean. Mean what you say. And don't say it mean. Clarity. Courage. Kindness.

Internship Program

Since its founding, volunteerism has been an integral part of Kiva's foundation and success. As a Kiva Intern, you will contribute your passion, drive, ideas, and expertise to expanding our reach and impact while taking on immediate and significant responsibilities within your team. In addition to learning on the job, you'll partake in a variety of educational, social, and professional development workshops and events that will accelerate your professional growth while learning about Kiva and the non-profit, technology, and microfinance sectors. 

Through this volunteer internship, we hope to provide a high-caliber learning experience. With the completion of our internship program, you will take away many in-demand job skills. Additionally, all Kiva interns will gain exposure to foundational microfinance concepts and ongoing professional development tailored to your career goals. This position will also put you in contact with a wide array of employees around the world, giving you a jump start on networking opportunities.

This Kiva internship is a 6-month, part-time (24 - 32 hours per week), United States-based, remote volunteer position. 

Department overview:

Kiva U.S. is an innovative direct-to-borrower lending program. Launched in 2011, Kiva U.S. has experimented with different approaches to bring 0% capital to financially excluded entrepreneurs throughout the U.S.. With the mission to help underserved communities thrive, the Kiva U.S. program seeks to: 

  • Expand access to capital to traditionally underestimated entrepreneurs including women, people of color, and the underbanked
  • Lower the cost of that capital (by offering 0% interest, no fee loans)
  • Enable borrowers and local technical assistance providers to connect more directly so that borrowers receive application support and plug into local resources 

Your Role:

As a Kiva U.S. Operations Intern, you will work closely with our Operations team. The U.S. Operations team is responsible for all operations supporting the U.S. program— from the borrower application to credit underwriting to fundraising support to loan disbursal to risk assessment and repayment. We maintain the tools used by the U.S. team and our partners and strive to leverage them to meet our team’s needs as well as to better support both our borrowers and partners.

This intern will be responsible for driving forward the way we support entrepreneurs during the loan origination process (from the moment they start an application for a Kiva loan until they complete their fundraising campaign on kiva.org) and manage delinquency of our borrowers.

This role calls for the intern to gain a deep understanding of the entire borrower experience, take part in the review process of loan applications, and own process improvements to our system. The intern will also assist in analysis and project-based work (in areas including but not limited to: communications, data analysis, product, partner success, strategic partnerships, impact) help us continue to develop the U.S. program and drive greater impact for small business entrepreneurs in the U.S.

At this time, we can only consider applicants with authorization to work in the United States on a permanent, full-time basis; unfortunately we cannot provide visa sponsorship.

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Screening and approving loan applications alongside our review team.
  • Supporting borrowers via text and phone calls throughou

You will work alongside field quality engineers to help spot emerging hardware issues, investigate their root cause, and support fixes with engineering, manufacturing, and market operations teams. You will spend time hands-on with failed parts in the lab, and just as much time in the data working out how big a problem really is.

Responsibilities:

  • Support failure analysis on parts returned from the field, including requests from enterprise customers, by helping with teardown, inspection, and electrical testing and documenting findings with photos.
  • Help monitor field data, such as vehicle and station alerts and repair records, and flag emerging issues to the team.
  • Build and update dashboards and queries that track reliability metrics and retrofit progress.
  • Assist with field retrofit campaigns by helping identify affected units and tracking progress.
  • Help review repair SOPs and troubleshooting guides used by market mechanics, and suggest improvements.
  • Contribute to field failure investigations in Jira, working with engineers on root cause and corrective actions.

Experience:

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or Industrial Engineering, or a related field, at a Canadian university, graduating between December 2027 and summer 2028 (required). Master's students who worked between degrees should have less than 2 years of full-time experience.
  • Professional proficiency in French and English, written and spoken (required)
  • Hands-on comfort with electromechanical hardware, including disassembly, inspection, and basic electrical troubleshooting with tools like a multimeter
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with large, imperfect datasets to reach clear conclusions
  • Familiarity with structured problem-solving methods (5 Whys, fishbone diagrams, 8D, FMEA)
  • Curious and detail-oriented, with clear written communication
  • Previous internship or co-op in quality, reliability, test, or failure analysis is a plus
  • SQL or Python, and experience with Mode, Hex, Tableau, or Power BI, is a plus
  • Familiarity with Jira or similar ticketing tools is a plus
  • Exposure to e-bikes, batteries, automotive, or other electromechanical products, or to reading wiring diagrams, is a plus

Benefits:

  • Mental health benefits
  • In addition to holidays, interns receive 2 days paid time off and 3 days sick time off
  • Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

As a Process Engineering Intern, you’ll join a dynamic team committed to strengthening the world’s energy systems to make them more resilient, efficient, and reliable.

Based at our global headquarters in Houston, TX, MetOx is seeking a motivated fall Process Engineering Co-Op/Intern to join our team. This role offers hands-on experience with production processes, data analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. You'll gain exposure to advanced manufacturing techniques and collaborate closely with seasoned engineers on critical projects.

This position is part of MetOx’s 2027 Co-Op/Intern Program. Candidates may be considered for one of two options:
  • Internship: Part-time during the school year (Spring 2027) and full-time during Summer 2027.
  • Co-Op: Full-time from January through August 2027. Non-local candidates selected for the full-time co-op may be eligible for a monthly stipend to help offset living expenses during the co-op period.

Key Responsibilities:

Characterization and Testing

  • Operate tools like SEM, EDX, Optical Microscopy, XRD for defect identification, library maintenance, correlation of defects to Ic & mechanical properties of the product.
  • Carry out sample preparation techniques like selective etching, cross section polishing, etc.
  • Perform destructive testing techniques like simple peel, cross hatch peel, 90-degree peel, transport Ic, electromechanical property tests.

Process Engineering Support

  • Hands on support to process engineers in performing Design of Experiments (DOE) and tracking/tracing product flow, collecting samples, testing and documenting results.
  • Perform Statistical data analysis on the information collected from the Design of Experiments (DOE).
  • Actively participate in root cause analysis, articulate and perform Hypothesis testing, document results.
  • Support Operations on disposition decisions, process changes, sample collection.
  • Follow through and verify operational accuracy when performing experiments, new process deployments, new product routings.

Data Management & Reporting

  • Use the existing systems to collect, articulate, summarize and present to the team.
  • Formulate defect tracking dashboards and build the trends. Correlate to process metrics.
  • Write and publish Failure Analysis (FA) reports, technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOP's), work instructions (WI's) as development progresses.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including production, quality, and maintenance, to support ongoing projects and resolve technical issues.
  • Participate in safety meetings and training sessions to understand and adhere to MetOx’s operational standards.
  • Attend project meetings, provide regular updates on process initiatives, and share insights to contribute to the team’s success.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree program in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a Ph.D. program in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • Previous internship or co-op experience in a process or manufacturing engineering role.
  • Experience with characterization tools like SEM, EDX, Optical Microscopy, XRD.
  • Familiarity with statistical analysis tools (JMP or Minitab).
  • Experience working in a lab or manufacturing environment with a strong focus on safety protocols. 

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

  • Basic understanding of process engineering principles, Lean Manufacturing, and Six Sigma methodologies.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel for data analysis and reporting.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret technical information effectively.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Physical Demands: This position requires sitting at a desk and viewing a computer screen for extended periods while working or performing other office tasks. Ability to move around the office, including occasional standing, walking, and bending to retrieve documents, attend meetings, or use office equipment. Some light lifting may be required, up to 20 lbs.

  • Outstanding problem solving skills with proper data structures and algorithms.
  • Excellent software development skills at least in one programming language
  • Major/minor in Mathematics or relevant coursework/experience is a plus

  • Fluent in English and Korean (both verbal and written)

description:
About Marshall Wace

Marshall Wace is a leading global alternatives investment manager with around $85bn in assets under management and over 700 employees working across London, New York, Hong Kong, Singapore, Shanghai, and Abu Dhabi.  Operating as a single team across the globe, we are dedicated to creating long-term relationships with our clients built on trust and integrity. We define our culture as one of continuous innovation and a quest for improvement. We instinctively strive to do things differently, with fresh thinking that enables us to create proprietary value and maximise the benefits to our clients.

We manage quantitative, systematic, and fundamental strategies, specializing predominantly in long/short equity. Our strategies are implemented globally, leveraging proprietary systems and processes. Technology and data have been at the core of our business for more than two decades. In 2002, we launched MW TOPS, the world’s first ‘Alpha Capture’ application. Today, we continue to foster an environment focused on innovation and the pursuit of excellence.

The Opportunity

The Quant Implementation team builds the systems that connect quantitative research to live trading within Marshall Wace’s systematic investment business. Quantitative developers design, implement and maintain alpha algorithms and portfolio construction processes, translating research ideas into robust production systems. The role combines quantitative problem-solving with software engineering and the challenge of operating reliable, high-performance systems at scale.

As a Quant Implementation Intern, you will gain first-hand exposure to the full lifecycle of a systematic investment idea—from research and data analysis through portfolio construction, implementation and performance monitoring. This is not a pure software engineering internship: you will use technology as a tool to solve investment problems and will develop an understanding of how systematic strategies make decisions, manage risk and generate trades.

You will join a collaborative global team and contribute to meaningful projects with direct relevance to the investment process. The internship is well suited to someone who enjoys combining quantitative thinking, markets and hands-on problem solving.

What You Will Do

  • Analyse market and portfolio data to understand signal behaviour, trading outcomes and strategy performance.
  • Help validate new models and portfolio construction changes before they are introduced into live trading.
  • Investigate differences between research expectations and real-world results, considering data, market, risk and implementation effects.
  • Contribute clean, reliable code to systems that support live systematic strategies.

Examples of Internship Projects

  • Analysing how transaction costs, liquidity or portfolio constraints affect a strategy’s realised performance.
  • Building analytics to explain portfolio positioning, risk exposures or recent trading activity.
  • Improving a portfolio construction process to support a new market, instrument or investment objective.
  • Developing monitoring that helps the team identify unusual model or trading behaviour.

What We Are Looking For

  • Currently studying toward a master’s or PhD in a quantitative subject such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering or a related discipline.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in applying them to financial markets.
  • Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, C++, Java or a similar language.
  • A solid foundation in probability, statistics, linear algebra or numerical methods.
  • Curiosity about systematic investing and a desire to understand why a strategy works—not only how to code it.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across research and technology teams.
  • Care, ownership and sound judgement when working with data and code.

Prior finance experience is helpful but not required. We are more interested in evidence of intellectual curiosity, rigorous thinking and enthusiasm for learning how quantitative ideas are translated into live investment decisions.

What You Will Gain

  • Direct exposure to systematic investing and the practical decisions behind live portfolios and trades.
  • Experience working alongside quantitative researchers, traders and experienced developers.
  • An understanding of the gap between a promising research result and a robust, scalable investment process.
  • Mentoring, technical guidance and opportunities to learn about different strategies, markets and asset classes.
  • The opportunity to see your work contribute to real investment workflows during the internship.

Why Join Us?

This internship offers a rare combination of quantitative research, software engineering and commercial investment exposure. You will work on problems where technical quality matters because the output influences real portfolios, while developing a practical understanding of markets and systematic trading.

We value people who ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions and work collaboratively to deliver results. If you are excited by the idea of using quantitative methods and technology to help turn investment research into live trading, we would like to hear from you.

About the Company

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

About the Job

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean’s harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

As a Summer 2027 Engineering Intern, you will work on real technical problems that directly support the development and scaling of our Node technology.

We expect to hire interns across several engineering disciplines, including mechanical engineering, manufacturing, and software. Your specific project and responsibilities will depend on your background, interests, and the highest-priority technical needs of the team. You will work alongside experienced engineers, technicians, and operators.

We are looking for exceptional students who have demonstrated technical ability, intellectual curiosity, initiative, and a track record of building, solving, or shipping difficult things.

You will be expected to learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions, document your work, communicate openly, and take meaningful ownership of your project. Candidates should have effective interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities will vary by discipline and project, but may include:

  • Own and execute a clearly defined technical project supporting our Node technology with guidance from experienced team members.
  • Apply engineering fundamentals and analytical reasoning to solve technical problems.
  • Build, test, troubleshoot, or improve physical or software systems.
  • Analyze technical data and use results to inform engineering or process decisions.
  • Create clear technical documentation, including designs, analyses, test results, software documentation, or process records.
  • Participate in technical reviews and clearly communicate findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations.
  • Take ownership of assigned work and proactively communicate progress and blockers.
  • Incorporate feedback quickly and adapt as project priorities or requirements evolve.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s, master’s, or doctoral degree in an engineering, computer science, physics, or other closely related technical field.
  • Strong technical fundamentals relevant to your area of study.
  • Demonstrated experience applying technical skills through coursework, research, internships, student teams, independent projects, or other hands-on work.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable working on problems where requirements or solutions may initially be ambiguous.
  • Able to work full-time and on-site in Portland, Oregon for the duration of the internship, approximately mid-June through early September 2027.
  • Authorization to work in the United States for the full duration of the internship.

Desired Qualifications

  • Mechanical design, CAD, structural or thermal analysis, or hardware testing.
  • Manufacturing engineering, process development, tooling, automation, quality, production systems, or design for manufacturability.
  • Software development, data systems, automation, simulation, controls, infrastructure, or developer tooling.
  • Skills with machining, fabrication, welding, electronics assembly, and prototyping.
  • Designing and executing technical tests and analyzing the resulting data.
  • Participation in technically demanding student teams or projects such as Formula SAE, Baja SAE, robotics, rocketry, solar car, marine engineering, or similar programs.
  • Experience taking a project from an ambiguous initial problem through implementation and validation.
  • Exposure to renewable energy, marine systems, robotics, aerospace, industrial systems, manufacturing, or other complex hardware environments.
  • Experience working in a fast-moving technical environment where designs, processes, or software are tested and iterated quickly.

The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed.

Compensation 

If hired for this internship, you will receive:

  • Cash compensation of $42.00 per hour. 

Location and Duration

  • This is an on-site position. Our offices, lab, and shop are located in Portland, Oregon. You must commit to being in person, in Portland, for the duration of this internship. 
  • This internship will run from mid-June through early September, with exact dates to be confirmed.

description:
About Re:Build 

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions. 

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation. 

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles) 

About Re:Build Optimation

At Re:Build Optimation, we specialize in delivering custom-engineered process equipment and automated systems to clients across the globe. With nearly 40 years of experience in complex chemical process systems, we have built a reputation for precision, reliability, and innovation. Our multidisciplinary team of 70+ engineers, designers, and programmers, combined with 150,000 square feet of fabrication space and over 70 skilled tradespeople, allows us to provide full turnkey solutions—from initial concept through fabrication, installation, and commissioning.

As part of Re:Build Manufacturing, we leverage the strength of a national industrial powerhouse while maintaining the agility and personalized service of a niche firm. We serve industries ranging from traditional and green energy to chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, glass, and advanced manufacturing, offering tailored solutions that optimize efficiency and performance.

At Re:Build Optimation, we believe in a collaborative approach, working closely with our clients to develop solutions that align with their unique operational goals. Our deep industry expertise and end-to-end capabilities make us the ideal partner for companies seeking cutting-edge automation, process control, and engineered systems.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a motivated Construction Management student who wants hands-on experience supporting real-world construction, installation, and manufacturing projects. You’ll work alongside Project and Construction Managers, engineers, skilled trades, subcontractors, and vendors while gaining exposure to projects from early-stage pilots through installation and commissioning.

You are organized, curious, and comfortable learning in both field and shop environments. You communicate clearly, take initiative, and are willing to ask questions while building your understanding of project execution, safety, quality, scheduling, and cost management.

This co-op/internship is a strong fit if you want practical experience that builds a foundation for a future career in project or construction management.

What You Get To Do

  • Support Project and Construction Managers with the day-to-day execution of field installation and shop fabrication projects.
  • Track project schedules, milestones, budgets, and deliverables, identifying potential delays or issues for the project team.
  • Participate in site walk-throughs and inspections to observe project progress, quality, and safety conditions.
  • Coordinate with subcontractors and vendors on schedules, deliverables, and follow-up items.
  • Document project progress through site photos, status reports, meeting notes, and punch lists.
  • Maintain punch lists and help track outstanding items through completion and project closeout.
  • Support safety and quality activities on client job sites, identifying and escalating concerns when appropriate.
  • Assist with commissioning activities as systems transition from installation to operational status.
  • Collaborate with engineers, skilled trades, and field personnel to gain exposure to the full project lifecycle.
  • Maintain organized project records, including reports, photos, correspondence, and other documentation.
  • Follow Re and client safety requirements, including PPE and site-specific procedures, while working in field and shop environments.

What You Bring To The Team

We aren't just selling radios, we're building the digital foundation for the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't work at a desk.

Why Join Relay?

  • A Proven Winner: Join a hyper-growth company trusted by over 10% of the Fortune 500, continuing to move upmarket with massive impact.
  • High Value, High Impact: With 47% of our revenue from $100K+ ARR customers and 135% Net Revenue Retention (NRR), you'll be joining a company rooted in value creation.
  • Market-Leading Innovation: The Relay platform captures 1 billion new data points weekly and features award-winning AI tools like TeamTranslate™, with 500% YoY growth.
  • World-Class Leadership: Our stellar leadership team is built to help us scale toward our next major milestones.
  • The Relay Culture: We're dedicated to helping you do the best work of your life (BWIML), investing in your growth, living out our CHASE values, and learning from talented teammates who make the work and the wins better every day.

Now, here's what we're building, and where you come in.

About the Role

Value Engineering at Relay is the bridge between frontline operational reality and enterprise investment decisions. Our Value Engineers parachute into a prospect's world, learn how they operate, and build the financial case that proves Relay's ROI at the C-suite level. This is analytical, customer-facing, high-stakes work. This internship puts you in the middle of it.

The Value Engineering Internship is a two-phase opportunity: a Spring semester engagement (January start, part-time) that potentially feeds into a full-time 40-hour/week Summer internship for top performers. Both phases are on-site at Relay's world-class Raleigh HQ, located near the Lenovo Center.

Strong performance creates a pathway to a return offer for a Summer or Fall 2027 internship and full-time consideration upon graduation, based on business needs.

You'll work directly with our Manager, Value Engineering, and the broader GTM org. This includes Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and senior leadership — on live enterprise deals.

About the Team

The Value Engineering team exists to close two critical gaps: leadership isn't always in touch with the factory floor, and new technology doesn't always translate into operational impact. We bridge both by quantifying Relay's value proposition, building investment-grade business cases, and acting as a forcing function for customer ROI. Our work shapes the enterprise sales motion, customer relationships, product roadmap, and company strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Support the development of executive-level business cases that translate frontline operational data into P&L-level ROI.
  • Map prospect workflows and analyze operational metrics to identify Relay's highest-impact use cases.
  • Build financial models that quantify the value Relay delivers across manufacturing, logistics, hospitality, and healthcare.
  • Partner with AEs and CSMs on pilot strategies and account planning for key enterprise opportunities.
  • Conduct research on industry operations and competitive benchmarks to strengthen Relay's value narratives.
  • Assist in developing internal tools, ROI frameworks, and proofs-of-concept that scale across the sales org.
  • Synthesize customer and field insights to support product roadmap and pricing strategy conversations.
  • Contribute to the company's wildly well-attended intern showcase — presenting your work to Relay's full team at summer's end.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Expected graduation between December 2027 and May 2029.
  • Minimum GPA of 3.7
  • No employer work authorization sponsorship available — candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship, now or in the future.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills; comfortable building models and working with data.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — ability to synthesize complexity into a clear, executive-ready narrative.
  • Available to work onsite at Relay's Raleigh HQ (near the Lenovo Center) for both the Spring engagement and the full-time Summer program.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Coursework or project experience in operations research, systems engineering, supply chain, or financial analysis.
  • Exposure to manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, or hospitality environments through coursework, co-op, or personal experience.
  • Familiarity with data analysis tools (Excel, Python, SQL) and/or data visualization.
  • A genuine curiosity about how physical-world businesses operate and where technology creates real impact.

What success and impact look like in this role

By the end of the Spring engagement, you've shipped at least one analysis or framework that's been used in a live enterprise deal. By mid-summer, you're running financial models and contributing to business cases with real ownership — not just support. By the final showcase, you've presented work that a senior leader would put in front of a Fortune 500 prospect.

Seattle Sounders FC is a progressive high performing collection of people who strive to achieve the highest levels of our sport while making a transformative impact in our communities in the best soccer city in America. Our culture is focused on serving one of the most passionate sports fan bases in North America who are invested in the Sounders as much for our commitment to making a positive impact in our communities as they are for winning the 2019 MLS Cup, 2022 CONCACAF Champions League and 2025 Leagues Cup on home soil. We exist to create special moments like these, where we enrich lives and unify our fans and city through soccer.

 

POSITION SUMMARY 

Seattle Sounders FC Performance team is offering an educational internship during Spring, Summer and/or Fall immersion blocks in 2027.  This internship offers unique experiences to strengthen learning and engage skillsets within Performance Training. Students will gain invaluable experience in a professional sports setting and an understanding of program design.

Eligible candidates must have at a minimum a Bachelor’s degree and certification from NSCA-CSCS, CSCCa, and/or USAW. Ideally students are able to commit for approximately 650 hours and start and end dates will be determined with each intern.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Support and Collaboration: Play a crucial role in supporting the performance, science, and nutrition sectors within the Seattle Sounders FC, aiding all teams within the club.
  • Training Assistance: Assist in the setup and execution of all First and Second team training sessions, including GPS tracking, warm-up routines, and on-field conditioning.
  • Session Preparation: Help prepare and conduct First and Second team mobility, lifting, and activation sessions.
  • Data Analysis: Support the collection and analysis of GPS, monitoring, and performance testing data.
  • Work Environment: Contribute to a dynamic, ambitious, and enjoyable work atmosphere.
  • Assist with the setup and breakdown of weight room and field equipment.
  • Maintain cleanliness and order of the weight room and its equipment.
  • Support during lifting and field sessions through supervision and demonstration.
  • Participate in Performance Science Innovation and Initiatives.
  • Contribute to the design, development, and delivery of curriculum projects as determined by the Performance Staff.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree and certification from NSCA-CSCS, CSCCa, and/or USAW.
  • CPR/AED certification is mandatory.
  • This is an unpaid internship. Must be able to receive academic credit towards a credited program.
  • Affiliation agreement must be executed between University and Seattle Sounders prior to start.
  • Exceptional communication skills to deliver programs effectively and interact professionally with colleagues, players, and coaches.
  • A keen interest in soccer or sports in general.
  • An enthusiastic and proactive approach to tasks.
  • Excellent organization abilities, with a knack for managing workloads, prioritizing tasks, and adhering to deadlines efficiently.
  • Must have a keen eye and attention for detail.
  • Proficiency in computer use and quick to learn new software and processes.

 

WORK ENVIRONMENT 

  • This position will work from Sounders FC Headquarters & Training Facility in Renton WA and attending meetings and matches as needed.
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  • Must be able to facilitate own local travel.
  • Must reside within Washington state upon date of hire.
  • Must be eligible to work in the US without sponsorship.
  • Must adhere to the MLS Next Safety and Well-Being policy and any other relevant child safety policies.
  • Capable of prolonged periods of standing and lifting up to 65 lbs. Travel for business purposes and availability for weekend and holiday schedules are required.

 

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where every employee is respected, valued and supported. We celebrate our diverse work environment and welcome team members of all backgrounds and perspectives. To that end, if you do not meet every job requirement listed, we still encourage you to apply. We believe your relevant experience and expertise will help us become a high-performing best-in-class workplace for all. Women, gender-nonbinary, people of color, LGBTQIA+ people and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

The physical demands reflected in the duties and work environment herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. If you’d like to request an accommodation in the application or interview process, please do so by emailing the People & Culture Team.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Fraud Operations intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As part of optimizing the online shopping experience, Sezzle constantly monitors users and transactions for abusive or fraudulent behavior. Our Shopper Risk Operations team reviews suspicious activity flagged by Sezzle’s fraud detection system or escalated from Customer Support agents. Fraud Operations Interns will block users deemed fraudulent or risky, and clear false positive flags from our automated systems and support agents. We monitor for new trends in fraudulent behavior and continuously evolve our policies and procedures to stay one step ahead. We are looking for a teammate who can work full-time during the days and hours listed below:

  • Monday - Friday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - local time.

This will be a paid internship.

What You'll Do:

  • Monitor real-time transactions and other customer behaviors flagged for fraud and abuse for manual review.
  • Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to determine if the transactions are fraudulent or not.
  • Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.
  • Research fraud and user behavior to contribute to machine learning models, rules and other detection systems.
  • Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our fraud prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.
  • Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.
  • Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses.
  • Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.

What We Look For:

  • Experience in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment
  • Attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong business judgment and communication skills
  • Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Fraud Operations Intern is $800 USD gross monthly.

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and detail-oriented Product Operations Intern to join our Rewards team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Rewards is where Sezzle turns everyday shopping into value for our customers. Through the Earn experience in the Sezzle app, shoppers earn Sezzle Points by scanning receipts, completing offers, and engaging with our partners. Receipt scanning is one of our newest and fastest-growing earning features, and you'll be one of the people closest to it. You'll see how it works in the real world, find where it breaks, and help decide what gets fixed first.

This is an operations role with a strong product lens. You'll work with the product manager, engineering, design, and data teams to make sure the receipt scanning experience is accurate, fair, and hard to abuse. Your work will feed directly into what the team builds next. If you like finding patterns in messy real-world data and turning them into clear recommendations, this role is for you.

What You'll Do:

Receipt Quality & Validation Operations

  • Own the day-to-day quality of receipt scanning submissions. Review submissions against validation rules, make approve/reject decisions, and apply them consistently.
  • Spot edge cases the current system misses, such as unusual receipt formats, retailer-specific quirks, duplicates, and signs of abuse. Document them clearly so the team can handle them at scale.

Product Feedback & Prioritization

  • Turn what you see in submissions into actionable feedback for engineering: clear bug reports, reproducible examples, and suggested improvements to extraction and validation logic.
  • Keep a prioritized list of what needs improvement and why. Rank it by customer impact, fraud risk, and operational cost, and help the product manager bring it into planning.
  • Track fixes through the backlog. Follow up on status, confirm improvements work once shipped, and flag regressions.

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Write and maintain clear review guidelines, decision criteria, and escalation paths so decisions stay consistent as the program scales.
  • Find parts of the review workflow that can be automated, simplified, or removed. Help shape the internal tools the team uses.

What We Look For:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience 
  • A genuine interest in consumer fintech, rewards and loyalty programs, or how products run at scale behind the scenes
  • Strong attention to detail: you notice when something's off, and you care about getting it right every time, not just most of the time
  • A structured, logical mindset: you enjoy finding the pattern behind individual cases and turning it into a rule, a fix, or a recommendation
  • Effective written and verbal communication: you can write a bug report an engineer can act on right away, and summarize a trend clearly for a non-technical audience
  • Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to operations, product, fintech, data analysis, trust & safety, or startups is a plus. We hire for potential, not just pedigree.

Shift delivers AI agents that transform insurers' most critical work. By combining deep industry expertise and unmatched data resources, Shift provides proven results that have earned the trust of hundreds of the world's leading insurers. Our insurance-grade AI is accurate, explainable, and secure—empowering human experts to move with unmatched speed, total confidence, and a renewed focus on the people they serve.

 

Our culture is built on innovation, trust, and a drive to transform the insurance industry through our SaaS platform. We come from more than 50 different countries and cultures and together we are creating the future of insurance.

Learn more at www.shift-technology.com

 

 

Shift Technology : 

Shift is the leading AI platform for insurance. Shift combines generative, agentic, and predictive AI to transform underwriting, claims, and fraud and risk - driving operational efficiency, exceptional customer experiences and measurable business impact. Trusted by the world's leading insurers, Shift delivers AI when and where it matters most, at scale and with proven results.

The Data Science Team🤖: 

The Data Science team works on a broad range of subjects. We actively participate in the definition and development of our suite of products on fraud detection, anti-money laundering and claim automation. We have a lot of technical and professional experience in data science, data engineering, coding, business understanding, and client interactions. Additionally, we also work on various data types such as structured data, free text, documents, and images.

Your key responsibilities will include🧑‍💻:

  • Setting up and deploying data processing pipelines, such as data reception (batch or real-time), data cleaning, information extraction, and calibration of fraud detection models.
  • Conducting R&D to drive product innovation (machine learning, NLP, image analysis, trend analysis, chatbots, etc.).
  • Partnering in an entire Data Science product lifecycle: understand how sales, legal, product, and engineering are connected together to deliver an AI product to clients.

Your profile and requirements✅: 

  • You are currently enrolled as a master's degree student in either Mathematics,  Statistics, Computer Science, Machine learning and/or Big Data.
  • You must be able to provide an internship agreement (Convention de stage) signed by your school or university for 6 months and you are able to start your internship in NOVEMBER 2026
  • You have experience in object-oriented programming (OOP) such as prior internship, school and/or personal projects so you can write quality production code. Prior experience using C# is a plus.
  • French is mandatory at a fluent level and you can communicate clearly in English.

Why join Shift Technology as a Data Scientist Intern ? 

🤸‍♀️Flexibility, autonomy and adaptability are part of our core values: we are a horizontal organization without bureaucracy (40% of staff are data scientists) but optimal and reduced line management, focus on delivery and development while having a hybrid model.

🧠Learn from inside an AI leader tech company: join the 13th French Unicorn providing hands on training, workshop and sessions with highly experienced AI research Team.  

💶Your commitment, our investment: 2000€ gross monthly gratification, high  conversion rate to full time employee, dedicated HR partner, regular reviews and feedback sessions with your team.

🌍Be part of an international and diverse tech firm: full english speaking environment with 55 different nationalities across the world and 11 offices locations (Paris, Singapore, Tokyo, Sao Paulo, Mexico City, Boston, Madrid, London, Toronto, ...)

🤝Dealing with big clients and developing business skills & knowledge: real life experience with insurance business challenges inside the world of AI.  

What is next ? 🎯

If your application and experience meet our requirements, you can expect :

  • Talent Acquisition interview (30 min)
  • Technical interview 1 (60 min) 
  • Technical interview 2 (60 min) 
  • Hiring manager interview (60 min)

The interview process can take 2 to 3 weeks, depending on the interviewer's availability. Be sure that we are doing our best to get back to you with an answer as fast as possible. If you are not getting an update on your application after 10 days, please reach out to our email address.

Shift is the leading AI platform for insurance. Shift combines generative, agentic, and predictive AI to detect fraud, assess risk, and recommend actions throughout the claims process. Our teams tackle complex data challenges and bring advanced models into production at scale, giving insurers deeper insights into their data while helping their customers get paid faster and enjoy a smoother claims experience. Our technology is adopted and trusted by the world’s leading insurers.

The Data & AI Engineering Team 🤖:

The Data & AI Engineering team designs, builds, and maintains the platform that powers all of Shift’s products and features used by insurers. We bring together Data, Software, and ML/AI Engineers to tackle a broad range of technical challenges. Here are just a few of the areas we work on:

  • Predictive ML models, RAG systems and advanced agentic AI workflows for scoring and decisions;
  • Data storage: relational, NoSQL, and vector databases;
  • Data pipelines: ingestion, cleaning, transformation, and enrichment;
  • Unstructured data processing: text and documents;
  • Entity linking, entity resolution, and network detection using graph algorithms

Working closely with forward-deployed Data Scientists, we take end-to-end ownership of these components: from designing the architecture and implementing solutions together to overseeing deployments and maintaining and improving systems in production.

Your key responsibilities🧑‍💻:

You’ll own a feature of Shift’s Data & AI platform involving large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows, from initial exploration to production, which will improve our fraud detection or payment integrity models. You’ll be responsible for:

  • Understanding the business problem with our clients, Product teams, and domain experts
  • Exploring the state of the art, testing approaches, and identifying what works best for your use case
  • Designing the solution alongside our Architects and AI Research Lab
  • Building and integrating your feature within a cross-functional squad
  • Evaluating and improving performance, measuring accuracy (precision / recall) and latency
  • Deploying your feature into production in collaboration with our forward-deployed Data Scientists

Along the way, you’ll discover how Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Data Science, Security, and other teams work together to deliver AI products to clients. Your work will go beyond a prototype: you’ll help put an AI feature into production, powering solutions used by insurers around the world.

At Sigma, we’re not just adding AI—we’re building the future of how people work with data. Your work will become an integral part of the workflow for the thousands of enterprises that run on Sigma. We're looking for PhD students that are passionate about the intersection of AI, business, and data.

  • Conduct original AI/ML research in search, recommendations, natural language processing, agentic workflows and more
  • Prototype and productionize AI systems that feel intuitive but do a lot under the hood
  • Tackle novel UX problems at the intersection of AI, analytics, and data apps
  • Contribute to the development of scalable AI/ML infrastructure for experimentation, training, and evaluation of large-scale models.

What You Bring

  • Current PhD student studying AI/ML at a U.S. accredited university
  • Deep understanding of machine learning, including deep learning algorithms, model architectures and optimization
  • Baseline understanding of building and deploying production-grade AI/ML systems
  • Knowledge of the full ML lifecycle: data curation, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Desire to bridge research and application—bringing new AI ideas from concept to impactful deployment.

  • You’ve fine-tuned or trained foundation models (language or multimodal) for novel domains
  • You know your way around cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • You’ve worked in a fast-moving startup or high-growth environment

Our cutting-edge memory technologies are essential in today's most advanced electronic devices and IT infrastructure, enabling enhanced performance and user experiences across the digital landscape.

We're looking for innovative minds to join our mission of shaping the future of technology. At SK hynix memory solutions, you'll be part of a team that's pioneering breakthrough memory solutions while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainability. We're not just adapting to technological change – we're driving it, with significant investments in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and eco-friendly solutions and operational practices. As we continue to expand our market presence and push the boundaries of what's possible in semiconductor technology, we invite you to be part of our journey to creating the next generation of memory solutions that will define the future of computing.

 

Internship Duration: 6 months

Hours: 40 hours per week

Start Date: Immediately (September/October 2026) 

Location: San Jose

 

About the role:

We are hiring a research intern in loop engineering: best practices for closed-loop flows that automate, optimize, and explore SoC designs. These are AI-assisted hardware/software co-design flows. CHIA, from UC Berkeley, is one example of a framework you may use.

You will own a scoped research question with a full-time researcher: build or extend the loop, run the experiments, and write up what the results mean for design automation.

 

What you will do:

  • Study how a design loop should be structured: which steps belong in it, what feedback each step returns, and how search, verification, and physical-design results drive the next iteration.
  • Implement the loop with languages and tools such as Chisel and XLS, together with simulation, software build, and physical-design tools.
  • Apply it to an SoC problem such as microarchitectural exploration, RTL implementation and verification, or power, performance, and area optimization.
  • Compare loop designs on the quality of the design point, the cost of the search, reproducibility, reuse, and how reliably a failure is diagnosed.
  • Make the loop reliable enough to rerun: clear interfaces between steps, cached results, regression checks, and reports that support a conclusion.

 

What you bring:

  • Progress toward a bachelor’s, master’s, or Ph.D. in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related field.
  • Coursework or project experience in loop engineering, computer architecture, digital design, VLSI, or electronic design automation.
  • Fluency in Python, and comfort reading and changing an existing codebase.
  • Ability to pose a small research question, keep a record of what changed, and explain the result.

 

Preferred:

  • Exposure to RTL (Verilog, SystemVerilog, Chisel, or XLS) or to an SoC design framework.
  • Experience with an architecture simulator or with RTL simulation.
  • Familiarity with an AI-assisted hardware/software co-design loop framework, such as CHIA, or with scripted hardware design, verification, or design-space exploration flows.

 

What success looks like:

By the end of your internship, you will have a rerunnable co-design loop applied to an SoC problem, a comparison of what worked and what it cost, and a short report on the practice the team should adopt.

 

COMPENSATION: $35/hr - $45/hr
